## Features
- Shows session and completed-turn cost estimates. The session chip sits in the composer, and the tu

rn chip follows the official turn usage pill, with the clock last. Both use the price tag icon.
- Ad
ds a **Cost statistics** entry to the sidebar **Plugins** area. Select it to open the cost overview

page.
- Shows a short initialization message when model prices are not ready.
- Groups the details b
y peak price, off-peak price and fixed price. Hides price rows that cost zero and shows no peak or o

ff-peak token counts.
- The session panel groups the four prices by peak, off-peak and fixed price,
then lists each model's group sums. The turn panel lists the four prices of every group for each mod

el.
- Each price has an info button: hover it to see the calculation formula for that price. The pop

over closes when the pointer leaves.
- Groups used models by provider. The list comes from DSH sessi

on history and models declared in the configuration.
- Supports separate prices for each full `provi

der/model` name.
- Selects models.dev, openrouter.ai or api.deepinfra.com as the price source.
- Ini
tializes new model prices from the selected source's local cache. Uses zero if there is no matching

price.
- Downloads model prices only when you select **Sync prices**. The source controls, the Sync

prices button and the sync report stay above the model rates table.
- Syncs only configured models.

The sync result is staged in the draft and written to the configuration when you select **Save**.
-
Matches source prices by model ID. models.dev prefers manufacturer prices; OpenRouter and DeepInfra

supply their own platform prices. Keeps existing prices if matching is unclear.
- Keeps existing pri

ces when the source cannot supply a supported rate.
- Supports USD or CNY for each model. Converts a

ll four rates when you change its currency.
- Shows separate USD and CNY totals when a session or tu

rn uses both currencies.
- Keeps edits in a page draft. The **Save** button at the end of the page w
rites the configuration. Leaving the page discards unsaved edits. A failed save shows the error and

keeps the draft.
